column3: Greetings, mortal. My servants tell me I can get my attire cleaned in this esteemed... establishment?
(Bubbly) Yes, silly! Didn't you see the huge neon sign that says "Clean for the Mean"?
(Fresh) Nice, looks like word of my "esteemed establishment" got around.
Indeed. Would you be able to return this here shirt to it's original, pristine condition?
As you can see it is stained with blood.
(Dry) I'm in business with evil. Getting rid of blood is my bread and butter.
(Bubbly) Oh, that's a big one! The other guy didn't live to tell the tale, I imagine. Good on you!
(Fresh) Blood? That's looks more like wine to me, Pookie.
It's a big stain and I can assure you it's blood. Blood indeed.
I should know, I'm a vampire elder. Baronex Duskmantle of Midnight's Keep to be exact.
(Dry) It smells like wine, it looks like wine. I will treat it like wine.
(Bubbly) But it smells like... Oooh, got it. Of course dear Baronex I will totally get rid of this BLOOD stain for you!
(Fresh) Whatever the stain, I'll make sure to get that shirt back on you asap.
Ich bin ein Vampir, magst du Vampire?
